{"text":"ItemID: NA; Title: St. Anger       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Heavy enough for my current mood, but I would choose more melodic material this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Shangri-LA DEE DA; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Fits my rock interests, though I am currently leaning toward the heavier side of my listening.
ItemID: NA; Title: MTV Unplugged in New York; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: An acoustic set is less appealing while I am looking for the intensity of Ten Thousand Fists and 10.000 Days.
ItemID: NA; Title: City of Evil       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Its melodic metal and energetic guitar work fit my interest in Chuck and Advance And Vanquish.
ItemID: NA; Title: Master of Puppets; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: The intricate riffs and sustained intensity appeal to the heavier preferences reflected in Colony and Figure Number Five.
ItemID: NA; Title: Steal This Album!       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: The forceful vocals and unpredictable rhythms sound appealing after my recent Tool and Disturbed listening.
ItemID: NA; Title: Metallica; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The heavy, accessible songs fit my taste, but Master of Puppets is my stronger pick this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Hybrid Theory; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Its mix of aggression and melodic hooks suits my interest in The Reason and Ten Thousand Fists.
ItemID: NA; Title: 12 Bar Blues; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its more experimental alternative rock direction is less aligned with my current interest in heavy riffs.
ItemID: NA; Title: Use Your Illusion II; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The melodic hard rock fits part of my history, but I would prioritize the metal selections today."}
